# Thanas R

> Portfolio of Thanas R - developer & creative problem-solver. Projects, blogs, resume, and contact.

Thanas R (also known as Thanas or Thanas Ramesh) is a developer studying at PES University, building thoughtful digital experiences across LLMs, Data-Science, AI/ML, and full-stack engineering.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, hero, about, projects, and contact.
- [Projects](/projects): Full list of projects built by Thanas R.
- [Blogs](/blogs): Long-form writing on development, AI, and design.
- [Resume](/resume): Work history, education, and skills.
- [About](/about.html): Background and bio.
- [Contact](/contact.html): Ways to get in touch.

## Projects

- [Nautilus](/projects/nautilus): AI knowledge tool with mindmaps and concept cards.
- [Virdis](/projects/virdis): AI-powered farm boundary mapping & crop health.
- [Spheal](/projects/spheal): AI travel planner with interactive maps.
- [PESU Minecraft S2](/projects/pesu-mc): Official site for PESU MC Server Season 2.
- [AskBookie_](/projects/askbookie): RAG document Q&A frontend.
- [Contour Flow](/projects/contour-flow): Procedural topographic map generator.
- [Smart Chef](/projects/smart-chef): TF-IDF recipe recommender.
- [ThanasOS](/projects/thanas-os): macOS-themed interactive portfolio.
- [PESU Forge](/projects/pesu-forge): AI study tool — flashcards, quizzes, mind maps.
